method: Fresh public git ls-remote, shallow source checkout, UTF-8 local test run and explicit native interop fixture execution
originalAssumption: The TINP OPP adapter only needed the older CHP/RCP negotiation surface.
observedEvidence: OPP latest main adds a candidate native interop runtime, interop receipt schema and a concrete producer-bridge-consumer fixture; all 41 OPP tests pass when the repository source is selected and UTF-8 is forced on Windows.
reasoning: OPP owns native interop semantics and receipt production. TINP can gain a bounded consumer acceptance observation by validating the external receipt without copying or reimplementing the OPP runtime.
impact: Add a TINP-owned receipt validator and acceptance binding; keep vendored OPP pinned and keep authorityGranted false.
rollback: Remove src/opp-native-interop.mjs, its tests and the OPP native interop evidence without changing TINP core, RCL or the vendored OPP source.
boundary: This is candidate local provider evidence, not independent third-party deployment, production authority, strong OS sandboxing or K400 promotion.
